name: ssdeep
description: Fuzzy hashing tool for comparing files based on similarity rather than exact matches

tools.description: Generate and compare context triggered piecewise hashes (fuzzy hashes) to find similar files
tools.usage:
ssdeep file.txt # Generate fuzzy hash
ssdeep -r /path # Recursive hash generation
ssdeep -m hashfile.txt -d /suspect # Compare against known hashes
ssdeep -b -r /samples > baseline.txt # Create hash baseline
ssdeep -x hashfile.txt file.exe # Match against hash database
